_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Adds get_capability_completeness (BI-B6157AAB): a READ-ONLY door onto the platform's own capability measure — which of the seven planes resolve for each of the 82 agent identities, plus the repo-level reference defects. It earns a permanent place because the platform is supposed to close its own gaps: without it, only a human outside the system can see them, which is the condition this whole programme exists to end. It adds nothing to the ACTING surface — it reports, and never changes authority.

registry.packFiles.reason: Adds capability-completeness-pack, the single-tool pack serving get_capability_completeness. Kept as its own pack rather than folded into an existing one so its read-only contract stays legible: the pack declares one grant (registry_read) and no side-effecting handler.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
